title: News 11.19.2026
content: Targeting a cellular “traffic jam” treats multiple diseases in mice Broad researchers have developed a therapeutic strategy that clears cells of misfolded proteins at the root of a group of genetic diseases. By Sarah C.P. Williams November 19, 2026 Credit: Riedl Khursigara M, Goss AC, et al. Neuron. DOI: 10.1016/j.neuron.2026.10.023 Microscopy images of mouse kidney tissue show the hallmarks of MUC1 kidney disease (left) and the effect of targeting a key protein, TMED7, (right) as a possible therapeutic strategy.
